events.ticker_label: 💥 India: Umar Khalid, Sharjeel Imam go back to Supreme Court for bail

events.title: British comedian and actor Russell Brand found guilty of rape
events.description: Prosecutors labeled Brand a sexual predator. He was charged in sexual assault cases spanning from 1999 to 2009.

events.title: Tech stocks plunge as US midterm results fuel fears of tighter AI rules
events.description: Asian tech stocks fell sharply on Friday, driven by fears of tighter AI regulation following Democrats’ US midterm election victory. US voters widely oppose Data centres, and many winning candidates pledged to curb their development.

events.title: Family of footballer who died after on-pitch collision pay tribute to him
events.description: Family, friends and teammates gathered for the funeral of the Spanish footballer who died following an on-field collision with another player.
events.ticker_label: 💥 Family of footballer who died after on-pitch collision pay tribute to him

events.title: Breakaway league LIV Golf to fold after filing for bankruptcy
events.description: Breakaway men's league LIV Golf is to fold instead of launching a new version because of a lack of financial support.

events.title: What to know about Pope Leo XIV's trip to Uruguay, Argentina and Peru
events.description: Pope Leo XIV is returning home to the continent where he spent two decades as a missionary priest and learned to be a pastor, visiting Uruguay, Argentina and his second homeland of Peru

events.title: Bus collides with truck in eastern Pakistan, killing at least 11 people
events.description: Officials say a passenger bus has collided with a truck in eastern Pakistan, killing at least 11 people and injuring 33 others

events.title: Nigerian court nullifies presidential contender’s candidacy 2 months before election
events.description: A Nigerian court has disqualified a leading presidential candidate, complicating the electoral process two months before the election
events.ticker_label: 💥 Nigerian court nullifies presidential contender’s candidacy 2 months before election

events.title: Small eastern Caribbean archipelago seeking slavery reparations holds general election
events.description: Grenada and other eastern Caribbean islands are voting in general elections

events.title: UN's peacekeeping mission in Western Sahara enters liquidation phase after mandate expires
events.description: The U.N. peacekeeping mission in Western Sahara has entered a “liquidation phase” and is beginning to vacate positions and dispose of equipment following a U.S.-Russia standoff at the Security Council last week

events.title: British man being treated for Ebola in Congo is being evacuated to the UK
events.description: A British man being treated for Ebola in Congo is being evacuated to the U.K., the government said Thursday

events.title: Russian captain among 2 crew found guilty by Finnish court of damaging Baltic cables
events.description: A Finnish court has convicted the captain and another crew member of a cargo ship of damaging undersea telecommunications cables in the Baltic Sea last year

events.title: Indiana, Florida and Alabama carry out rare US triple execution day
events.description: Three inmates were executed by lethal injection in Indiana, Florida and Alabama on the same day, the second time that has happened in 2026.

events.title: Escaped Tennessee killer hid in Illinois shed with beer and garlic bread before capture: Sheriff
events.description: Jacob Allen Morley hid in an Illinois shed near Marion, drinking beer and making garlic bread before FLOCK cameras helped track the Tennessee escapee.

events.title: Marine veteran working security hailed as hero after stopping active shooter at Florida Citibank campus
events.description: Florida Marine veteran John Fraley took a tactical position in a restroom and shot the Citibank Center campus gunman five times, the sheriff said.

events.title: Cops return to New Jersey mother's home months after she was found stabbed and husband called 911
events.description: Police returned with at least 15 vehicles to Brooke Hanlon's Chester, New Jersey, home weeks after her autopsy ruled the stabbing a homicide.

events.title: MICHAEL RUIZ: 'Today' segment may explain key Apple Watch detail in Nancy Guthrie ransom note, expert says
events.description: A retired detective says Savannah Guthrie's "Today" show Tucson segment may have sparked her abductor's interest in Nancy Guthrie before her kidnapping.

events.description: Benjamin Netanyahu faces a critical test as President Isaac Herzog decides who will receive the mandate to form Israel's next government.

events.description: U.S. Special Envoy Steve Witkoff announced U.S.-mediated peace talks between Ukraine and Russia on Nov. 10 and 11, focusing on security arrangements and de-escalation.

events.description: Smaller Iranian ghost fleet tankers are slipping past the U.S. naval blockade carrying sanctioned LPG fuel to China via a shadowy Malaysia anchorage.

events.description: Abelardo de la Espriella claims over 32,000 arrests in 10 weeks as Colombia joins Trump's anti-cartel coalition, pivoting away from predecessor's policies.
